items.html: *And we shall explain the matter of these NHY of Tvuna. For behold, only their externality is what the Tzelem and the aforementioned Mochin clothe in, for the inner light does not remain here, because ZA has no power to receive it; and behold, it departs from there and gathers in the first half of Tvuna, and there it remains. It is therefore found that the NHY of Tvuna are without their life. However, their very externality is what descends within ZA, they themselves.
